blocks.orig: The Kijongo Bay Beach Resort lies on a pristine stretch of beach close to Saadani National Park, on the northeast coast of Tanzania. The resort offers two-story beach villas with kingsize beds downstairs and smaller double beds upstairs. Ensuite bathrooms are located downstairs, while the upper floors boast private verandas with daybeds overlooking the ocean. Families can stay in the Boma house with two ensuite bedrooms and a small sitting area. The restaurant offers a set menu of fresh dishes (including a kids’ menu), written daily on a blackboard so you can inform the staff of any dietary wishes. A swimming pool helps to cool down, as does the ocean just a few steps further. Activities include kayaking, snorkeling, turtle watching or river cruises, but ‘doing nothing’ is ranked high. Sit back, relax and enjoy the simple things in life!
blocks.html: On the northeast coast of Tanzania, the Kijongo Bay Beach Resort sits on an unspoilt stretch of beach near Saadani National Park. Its two-storey beach villas have king-size beds on the ground floor and smaller double beds upstairs. The en-suite bathrooms are downstairs, and the upper floors have private verandas with daybeds looking out over the ocean. Families can stay in the Boma house, which has two en-suite bedrooms and a small lounge area. Each day the restaurant chalks up a set menu of fresh dishes (kids’ menu included) on a blackboard, so you can let the staff know about any dietary wishes. You can cool off in the swimming pool or in the ocean a few steps away. Kayaking, snorkelling, turtle watching and river cruises are all on offer, though ‘doing nothing’ is a popular choice too. Lean back, unwind and enjoy life’s simple pleasures!
